CoCoME_processSale_enterItem.text: The operation adds a scanned item and quantity to the current sale. It requires a current Sale that exists and is incomplete, and a scanned Item that exists and has positive stock. The entered quantity must not exceed the Item stock; this restriction is a laboratory-adjudicated requirement. The system creates a SalesLineItem linked to the Sale and Item, recording the quantity and a subtotal equal to the Item price times quantity. The Sale's contained sales lines include the new SalesLineItem. The system stores the new SalesLineItem in the SalesLineItem instance collection and makes it the current sale line. The Item stock decreases by the entered quantity. The operation returns true.

evidence.anchor: subtotal equal to the Item price times quantity
evidence.sourceText: The attribute Subamount of the object sli became the attribute Price of the object item times quantity

evidence.anchor: The Sale's contained sales lines include the new SalesLineItem.
evidence.sourceText: The object CurrentSale was linked to the object sli by ContainedSalesLine
The object sli was put into the instance set of class SalesLineItem

evidence.anchor: The entered quantity must not exceed the Item stock
evidence.sourceText: Reject a quantity greater than the selected Item's operation-entry stock.

Airport_manageUser_createStaff.text: The operation registers a new airport Staff member with contact, role and optional reporting information. The staff identifier must be unused. The system creates a Staff member with the supplied identity, password, phone and role. The new Staff member's name equals the supplied name. The system stores the new Staff member in the Staff instance collection. If bossid identifies an existing Staff member, the system links the new Staff member to that Boss. The operation returns true.

evidence.anchor: The new Staff member's name equals the supplied name.
evidence.sourceText: The new Staff member's name equals the supplied name.

evidence.anchor: The system stores the new Staff member in the Staff instance collection.
evidence.sourceText: The new Staff member is stored in the Staff repository.

evidence.anchor: The order amount becomes its amount before this operation plus the subtotal of every associated OrderEntry
evidence.sourceText: The final amount equals the operation-entry amount plus the sum of the subtotal of every associated OrderEntry.

CoCoME_processSale_makeCashPayment.text: The operation pays the current sale with the supplied cash amount. The current Sale must exist, be incomplete and be ready for payment. The tendered amount must cover the Sale amount, and a current Store must exist. The system creates a CashPayment recording the tendered amount and change equal to the tendered amount minus the Sale amount. The CashPayment is linked to the Sale, and the Sale's associated payment is that CashPayment. The system links the Sale to the current Store, and the Store's sales include that Sale. The system timestamps the Sale with the operation-entry time Now and marks it complete. The system stores the CashPayment in the CashPayment instance collection and returns true.

evidence.sourceText: The attribute Balance of the object cp became amount minus the attribute Amount of the object CurrentSale

evidence.anchor: the Store's sales include that Sale
evidence.sourceText: The object CurrentStore was linked to the object CurrentSale by Sales
The attribute Time of the object CurrentSale was equal to Now
The object cp was put into the instance set of class CashPayment
